info.title: Future AGI Management API
info.description: The endpoints defined below allow users to programmatically carry out various actions on the Future AGI platform.

get.description: Get workspaces for the current organization
Get workspaces for the current organization

List all dataset optimization runs with table config for dynamic columns.

Pagination: page (1-based); limit (page size).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A UUID string identifying this optimize dataset.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

post.description: Execute the widget's query_config against ClickHouse and return results.

post.summary: Execute a widget query and return chart data.
post.description:
Each metric carries a ``source`` field ("traces" or "datasets").
Metrics are partitioned by source and dispatched to the appropriate
query builder.  Results are merged into a single response.

Each metric is validated against the canonical query contract before
it reaches any query builder.

get.summary: Return all available metrics across traces and datasets.
get.description:
Backward compat: if ``workflow`` param is provided, return only
that source's metrics in the old grouped format.

Pagination: page (1-based); page_size (page size); cursor_mode (enable cursor pagination); cursor (opaque continuation token).

Return distinct values for a given metric/attribute, for filter value picker.

Pagination: page_size (page size); cursor (opaque continuation token).

parameters.name: property_id
parameters.description: Stable namespaced property identity returned by the metrics catalog. Legacy metric_name/metric_type remain accepted during migration.

get.summary: Get usage overview for the current billing period.
get.description:
Returns per-dimension totals, free allowances, estimated costs,
and projected month-end usage.

Query params:
    period: YYYY-MM (default: current month)
    workspace_id: optional (filter by workspace)

result.title: Result
result.description: String error message or structured account/login error metadata.

role.title: Role
role.description: User's job role (e.g., Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or custom role)

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: List of user's goals for using the platform

query_config.title: Query config
query_config.description: Saved query in the same shape as the dashboard query request: time_range and metrics are required once any metric is set, with optional workflow, project_ids, granularity, filters, and breakdowns.

chart_config.title: Chart config
chart_config.description: Chart presentation. chart_type must be one of line, stacked_line, column, stacked_column, bar, stacked_bar, pie, table, or metric.

allow_sampled.title: Allow sampled
allow_sampled.description: Deprecated compatibility parameter; accepted but ignored. The response explicitly labels exact, rollup, or unavailable provenance.

column_id.description: Column or attribute id to filter on.

property_id.description: Optional stable namespaced Property Registry identity.

display_name.description: Optional UI label for chips and saved views.

source.description: Optional source surface for mixed-source filters, for example traces, datasets, or simulation.

output_type.description: Optional metric output type metadata used by eval and annotation filters.

filter_type.description: Canonical field type, for example text, number, boolean, datetime, categorical, thumbs, annotator, array, or map. Legacy json is value-sensitive for SPAN_ATTRIBUTE filters: list values become array and object values become map.

filter_op.description: Canonical operator from api_contracts/filter_contract.json, for example equals, not_equals, in, not_in, between, not_between, is_null, or is_not_null.

filter_value.description: Scalar, list, range tuple, boolean, or null depending on filter_op and filter_type.

col_type.description: Column family such as SYSTEM_METRIC, SPAN_ATTRIBUTE, EVAL_METRIC, ANNOTATION, or NORMAL.

attribute_value_types.description: Optional storage-family provenance aligned one-for-one with filter_value for mixed SPAN_ATTRIBUTE in/not_in filters. Null entries retain filter_type semantics for manually entered values.
